results.title: Mishpucha
results.overview: A queer stripper has to face the Jewish family that shunned her in order to fulfill her beloved Bubbie's dying wishes.

results.title: I Remember Every Death
results.overview: Trapped in a brutal time loop where he remembers every death, a man must uncover the identity and rules of a sadistic architect who turned his life into a game, before the loop erases what’s left of his sanity.

results.title: Tales of the Sea
results.overview: Two young men from different backgrounds, with different upbringings and life stories, find themselves lost on a boat in the middle of the Mediterranean Sea. They soon realize that the only way for them to survive is to set aside their differences and work together.

results.title: Tanaru
results.overview: The Tanaru Indigenous Territory holds the memory and story of the 'Man of the Hole.' As the sole survivor of his people, he outlived the massacre that ravaged Rondônia during the 1990s.

results.title: Passing The Bar
results.overview: A job interview at a cocktail bar goes wildly off-menu when the interviewer decides to down every drink made for him.

results.title: Kalkutún, Trial of the Witches
results.overview: In 1880, an inexperienced prosecutor must indict a group of people accused of witchcraft and murder on the island of Chiloé. Meanwhile, a young peasant girl, to save her grandfather from the condemnation of the state, must be initiated into witchcraft.

results.title: German Federal Youth Orchestra @ Young Euro Classic 2026
results.original_title: Orchestre fédéral des jeunes d'Allemagne Young Euro Classic 2026
results.overview: The opening night of the 2026 Young Euro Classic festival brings together two rising stars of the classical music scene: conductor Aurel Dawidiuk and Georgian pianist Giorgi Gigashvili. Both aged 26, they will be performing with the German Federal Youth Orchestra.

results.title: The Catch of the Day
results.overview: A journalist investigates a group of fishermen's mysterious catch.

results.title: Invocation
results.overview: Fearing she won't survive the trip, a Latter-day Saint makes a deal with a benevolent stranger to help her reach Salt Lake.

results.title: Pluto
results.overview: Green alien Pluto feels like a misfit on his stop-motion planet.

results.title: The Wonder Bar
results.overview: Set against the timeless backdrop of Clarksburg's historic Wonder Bar Steakhouse, THE WONDER BAR is a heartfelt and thought-provoking faith-based drama about loss, redemption, and the power of human connection. Written and directed by Richard Grieco (21 Jump Street), the film showcases a deeply personal and compelling story brought to life by an outstanding ensemble cast.

results.title: Valet parking
results.overview: Fed up with being treated like criminals by the elite they serve, two valet drivers at a high-end restaurant embrace the prejudice and vanish into the night in a stolen car.

results.title: Kountry Wayne: Nostalgia
results.overview: Nostalgia is full of funny and hilarious moments mixed with the truth. It reminds us of how comedy was back in the day. It gives us that '90s feel-that funny, raw, fun, hard, Def Jam laughter-but at the same time, it holds informational, truthful, and enlightening moments. It's full of laughter, and it's the nostalgia of how you felt back in the day… before AI existed!

results.title: Syd
results.overview: As a cricketer, Dave Syd Lawrence was a fearsome fast bowler, who reached the top of the game to become the first British born Black man to play for England. Although his career was cut short by an injury described as one of the worst in sporting history, his achievements off the field have to be seen to be believed.

results.title: The Attack Of The Astroharvesters
results.overview: Three quirky friends discover a crashed alien spaceship and encounter far more trouble than they bargained for, luckily for them they meet the legendary alien hunter "Buck Ryder" and our heroes step up to defend the Earth from cosmic invaders.

results.title: Home Entertainment
results.overview: As television eclipses live theater in the early 1950s, a headlining tap-dancing showgirl is offered a shot at national fame - if she'll trade her artistic integrity for the constraints of the studio system.

results.title: Blacksmiths of Victory
results.overview: A story about fathers with many children who leave a peaceful life and volunteer for their homeland. A surgeon, a builder, a videographer and an entrepreneur become defenders of the motherland and mentors for their children.
